description: Keeps an existing Amazon EC2 instance running or stopped, with EC2's StartInstances and StopInstances. A deploy starts or stops the instance only when its state differs from the template's. Deleting it changes nothing in AWS: the instance stays as it is.

InstanceId.description: The ID of the instance, such as i-1234567890abcdef0. EC2 can stop only an instance whose root volume is an Amazon EBS volume. To start an instance whose EBS volumes are encrypted with a customer managed key, the caller needs kms:CreateGrant on that key, with the condition kms:GrantIsForAWSResource set to true.

State.description: The state to keep the instance in: running or stopped. While the instance changes state, a read returns EC2's state, such as pending or stopping.
